name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 4

function.text: MAP2K4 encodes dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 4. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and JUN kinase kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and JNK cascade.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Invasive Breast Carcinoma; Colorectal Adenocarcinoma; Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
